title: approvedMockup
responsibility: Stage only the approved option’s HTML, CSS, and screenshot bytes for the implementation agent.

inputs.name: approvedMockup.context
inputs.description: Change context with the approved option, selected revision, and planning artifact reader.

inputs.name: approvedMockup.version
inputs.description: Design version named by the current Change approval.

inputs.name: approvedMockup.directory
inputs.description: Temporary working directory owned and cleaned up by the Change run.

outputs.name: approvedMockup
outputs.type: Promise<{ directory: string; reference: string } | null>
outputs.description: Directory of the approved sources and screenshots, with its primary reference path. Absent for a legacy approval.

errors.name: MockupFailure
errors.description: The approved option has no recorded source or proposed screenshot.
